title: Single VLESS Reality TCP Vision node; no profile or subscription

server.description: Canonical global unicast numeric IP only; runtime rejects private/reserved/multicast and noncanonical forms.

servername.description: Runtime additionally checks DNS labels, requires dot, rejects IP/local suffixes.

reality_public_key.description: Runtime requires canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 bytes.

$comment: The runtime parser is authoritative: it also rejects duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, input >16KiB and bool-as-port. Empty template intentionally fails validation. Fixed type=vless, network=tcp, tls=true, skip-cert-verify=false, flow=xtls-rprx-vision, client-fingerprint=chrome. No optional config keys.
